When maneuvering with a weapon, you are committed to using it for a
strike. However, the clarification doesn't state if you have to use
it for your first strike. I'm guessing you must use the weapon for your
first strike regardless of additional strikes, but I want to make sure.

Mike

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mboh...@shout.net wrote:
> When maneuvering with a weapon, you are committed to using it for a
> strike. However, the clarification doesn't state if you have to use
> it for your first strike. I'm guessing you must use the weapon for your
> first strike regardless of additional strikes, but I want to make sure.

Yes. Updated rulebook: "If a minion has used a maneuver from a strike
(either a strike card or a weapon) this round, then he cannot choose any
other strike for his initial strike of the round." [6.4.3.1]
